title: Vaporesso DOJO Blast Pod & Refill For 10K or 30K Device – Lime Pomegranate
description: Please Note: Compatible with Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K & 30K Kits Only The Lime Pomegranate Prefilled Pod & Refill Pack is designed for the Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K vape kit, combining two bold fruit notes in one convenient package. Each pack contains a 2ml prefilled pod and an 8ml refill container, together providing up to 10,000 puffs of smooth, consistent vapour. Preloaded with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, the pods are powered by Vaporesso’s COREX 2.0 dual mesh coil and Smart Liq-Cycle saturation system for steady performance and rich flavour. This flavour blends the sharp zest of Lime with the deeper, tart sweetness of Pomegranate, creating a contrast that is both lively, intense and authentic. Fresh citrus meets juicy red fruit for a vape that stays bright and refreshing all day. With transparent pods for easy monitoring and a smart refill system to reduce mess, keeping your device topped up is quick and reliable.
